title: Cost-aware config safety simulator with batching & KV-cache rollback reconciler
creator: Asha Menon
description: Build a simulation-first rollback subsystem that evaluates config changes (batching, cache rules, quantization profiles, kernel hints) against cost and latency regressions before and during rollout, and provides automated safe reversion with state reconciliation. The feature has three parts: 1) offline simulation harness that runs synthetic and sampled live-replay workloads to estimate token cost, tail latency, cache-hit effects and failure modes under new configs; 2) a policy engine that converts observed deltas into actionable triggers with hysteresis and economic thresholds (eg. >15% cost increase per 1M tokens or >20% 99th latency regression for 5m) and safe mitigations; 3) a state reconciler + executor that applies staged canary rollouts, checkpoints runtime state (KV caches, batch scheduling seeds, kernel assignments), and if triggers fire, performs automated rollback while reconciling desired vs observed state to avoid split-brain or partial-applies. The goal is to reduce manual rollback toil, avoid cost regressions introduced by batching/cache changes, and ensure low-risk config promotion paths.
acceptance_criteria: Simulation harness can run a recorded workload replay and produce token-cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, cache-hit-rate, and error-rate deltas for a candidate config
Policy engine supports pluggable rules with thresholds and hysteresis windows and can emit PASS/WARN/FAIL decisions
Staged apply flow: canary (1%), ramp (10%, 50%), full with automatic checkpointing and the ability to rollback to last consistent checkpoint
Automated rollback executes idempotent revert with KV-cache reconciliation and logs an audit entry with root cause metrics
Integrations: Console shows simulation report, policy decision, and rollback rationale; alerting hooks send to PagerDuty and the ops Slack channel
E2E integration test that injects a config with intentionally harmful batching size and verifies rollback within configured SLOs
tech_notes: Leverage existing replay infra used by optimize-team for prefix workloads; extend to capture KV-cache warmup behavior
Need a lightweight state snapshot format: meta + cache checkpoints + batch-scheduling seed to enable deterministic rollback reconcilers
Policy thresholds should be configurable per-customer tier and per-model family; default conservative thresholds for hosted tier
Consider preflight 'economic delta' metric: estimated $/1M tokens change computed from token rate and batch efficiency delta
Failure modes: partial apply where some pools update before others — reconciler must detect asymmetric kernel assignments and force consistent state
Safety: all automated rollbacks must be gated by a cooldown and maximum frequency to avoid flip-flopping; provide manual override for emergency ops
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal dogfood in staging; run simulation on 3 production-like workloads and validate metrics (2 weeks)
Phase 1: enable simulator reports in Console for engineering-only (canary) and gather feedback (1 week)
Phase 2: enable policy engine with WARN only (no auto-rollback) for a subset of low-risk configs and measure false positive rate (1 week)
Phase 3: enable auto-rollback for non-critical configs with 1% canary traffic and conservative thresholds (2 weeks)
Phase 4: expand to Dedicated customers behind a feature flag and run joint exercises with SEs (2 weeks)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Simulator inaccuracies for edge input distributions -> Mitigation: sample live traffic for replay and conservative safety margins
Risk: Rollback causes cache cold start and temporary latency spikes -> Mitigation: checkpoint and warm caches on rollback target; staggered rollback with traffic draining
Risk: Policy overfitting to synthetic workloads -> Mitigation: continuous A/B monitoring and auto-tune thresholds based on historical telemetry
Risk: Rollback thrash under noisy metrics -> Mitigation: require multi-window confirmation (eg. 1m + 5m) and cooldown enforcement
implementation_steps: Design simulation spec and snapshot schema (owner: Liam) - doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/sim-safety-spec
Extend replay infra to include KV-cache and batching metrics (owner: infra-team) - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/replay/pull/812
Build policy engine service with pluggable rule definitions (owner: safety-core) - initial rules as config stored in runtime-configs
Implement staged apply executor with checkpointing and reconciler (owner: runtime-serving) - RFC: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SimSafetyRFC
Console integration for simulation reports and manual rollback UI (owner: console-ux)
E2E tests and chaos scenarios (owner: reliability)
